bottlenecks.label: incident: full blockage 60 s at x=1500 m

description: Two-lane freeway near capacity (3600 veh/h). A 60 s full blockage (incident) at x=1500 m during t=400-460 s triggers a stop-and-go wave that propagates backwards after the blockage clears, as in the Sugiyama et al. (2008) ring experiment.
name: stop_and_go_wave
